entries.name: ETSY_KEYSTRING
entries.description: The keystring of the KaratOS app on Etsy's developer site. It is also the OAuth client id, and goes with the shared secret in every request's x-api-key header.
howToGet: On Etsy's developer site, open Your Apps, then the KaratOS app, and copy its keystring straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: ETSY_SHARED_SECRET
entries.description: The KaratOS app's shared secret on Etsy. Sent only to Etsy, in the x-api-key header. With the keystring, it also encrypts the stored refresh token.
howToGet: On the same Your Apps page, copy the shared secret straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from connecting the shop with transactions_r and listings_r only. It seeds the stored token; the instance keeps the newest one encrypted in its database. It lasts 90 days without use.
howToGet: Have the shop owner connect the KaratOS app at https://www.etsy.com/oauth/connect with scope "transactions_r listings_r" and nothing else (PKCE is required).
Exchange the code at https://api.etsy.com/v3/public/oauth/token and copy the refresh token straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: ETSY_SHOP_ID
entries.description: The numeric id of the Etsy shop to read. The connector stops if the connection belongs to another shop.
howToGet: After connecting, GET https://api.etsy.com/v3/application/users/me answers the shop_id, or copy it from the shop's Etsy settings.
